searchText: hey there 🙂 Is `until_epoch` in https://ethereum.github.io/beacon-APIs/#/Validator/prepareSyncCommitteeSubnets inclusive or exclusive? would you expect to still be subscribed at epoch `until_epoch` or not? if it's inclusive, then maybe it would be better to rename it to `up_to_epoch` (sounds less ambiguous) unless the spec is frozen; in that case let's just add documentation no matter which way it is `until_epoch` sounds exclusive, but I think that it's inclusive (_i.e._ it should be the first epoch of the next sync committee period in usual operation). But it really depends on how the client teams have coded it, so will be interesting to hear their take on it. We implemented it as exclusive in Prysm. My personal opinion is that this should be documented in the spec and all teams should follow what the spec says, because the field name is ambiguous.
